name: Princess bedroom and dressing furniture
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "INT-SUITE-FURN-001 — Princess bedroom and dressing furniture". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Missing large bedroom/dressing furniture; existing mirrors, lamps, chairs and fabric masters reused

INT-SUITE-FURN-001-S01 — Canopy bed frame. Dimensions W,D,H [2.2, 2.7, 2.8]m proposed. One freestanding canopy bed frame with gold carved floral trim, rose upholstery or pearl wood/marble where appropriate, coherent legs/handles and useful rear view; no curtains/cloth fused to adjacent items.

INT-SUITE-FURN-001-S02 — Paired bedside cabinet. Dimensions W,D,H [0.65, 0.45, 0.75]m proposed. One freestanding paired bedside cabinet with gold carved floral trim, rose upholstery or pearl wood/marble where appropriate, coherent legs/handles and useful rear view; no curtains/cloth fused to adjacent items.

INT-SUITE-FURN-001-S03 — Wardrobe. Dimensions W,D,H [1.6, 0.65, 2.4]m proposed. One freestanding wardrobe with gold carved floral trim, rose upholstery or pearl wood/marble where appropriate, coherent legs/handles and useful rear view; no curtains/cloth fused to adjacent items.

INT-SUITE-FURN-001-S04 — Dressing table. Dimensions W,D,H [1.4, 0.5, 0.8]m proposed. One freestanding dressing table with gold carved floral trim, rose upholstery or pearl wood/marble where appropriate, coherent legs/handles and useful rear view; no curtains/cloth fused to adjacent items.
